{note}'''Note:''' Pocket services have shut down on July 8, 2025. Pocket integration with desktop Firefox was removed in [[Find what version of Firefox you are using|Firefox version]] 140 and in [[Firefox ESR release cycle|Firefox ESR]] (Extended Support Release) versions 115 and 128. You can export your saved items until November 12, 2025, before they are permanently deleted. To learn more, see [[Pocket has shut down - What you need to know|this article]].{/note}
